newsitem.title: UK: Sears says current sales up 6.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Sears says current sales up 6.2 percent.

text.p: Retailer Sears Plc said overall like for like sales in the first five weeks of the second half of its current financial year were up by 6.2 percent.
Retail like for like sales were up by 10 percent, reflecting continued growth at department store Selfridges and a strong performance from its womenswear stores.
Sales at childrenswear chain Adams have improved since the first quarter and the stores have maintained market share. Sears expects further improvement for the remainder of the year.
Footwear like for like sales in the second half so far are up by three percent. But Sears said the shoe market continues to underperform the rest of the clothing sector.

Home shopping sales are still below last year, but showing a steady recovery from the first half. The Autumn/Winter catalogue is producing encouraging results, and the number of sales agents is increasing. But Sears said it remained cautious about the outlook for the year.
Sears said overall it had seen an improvement in the retail environment and was confident of making solid progress in the year as a whole.
